content.title: Vaccine makers fall on FDA memo, Bally's wins bid for NYC casino
content.description:
Market Catalysts host Julie Hyman tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including the stock hit vaccine makers Moderna (MRNA), BioNTech (BNTX), and Novavax (NVAX) are taking on following a memo from the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA); casino operator Bally's (BALY) has won approval to run casinos in New York City; and Somnigroup International's (SGI) $1.6 billion offer to acquire Leggett & Platt (LEG).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.

content.title: Moderna Falls as FDA Vows to Impose New Vaccine Requirements
content.summary: Vinay Prasad, a top FDA official, blamed Covid shots for playing a role in the deaths of 10 children in the memo he sent to agency staff on Friday, which was seen by Bloomberg.  Moderna, which produces Covid shots, fell 4.1% at the start of regular trading in New York on Monday.
